title: Genotypes at one gene: Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium
intro: Illustrative data, made up for this book. 1,000 people were genotyped at a gene with alleles A and a: 298 AA, 489 Aa, 213 aa. The allele frequency p(A) = (2 × 298 + 489)/2000 = 0.5425, and Hardy–Weinberg expects p², 2pq and q². One parameter (p) was estimated from the data.
